document.abstract: The characteristics of Infra D film, a stock designed specifically for specialized cinematography, possessing distinctive spectral sensitivity, are described. The sensitivity is limited to two regions at opposite ends of the spectrum, a relatively wide gap occurring between. Examples of the use of the film in producing special pictorial effects are given in the illustrations.
